milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the red stained glass pane placed in the stone brick structure and look at it. The target is at spawn-relative (10, 2, 8), which is the top-center of the doorway opening in the front wall. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance (the structure is visible from spawn ~12 blocks away), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the pane rather than facing away.
